ordered_diagnoses: Osteomyelitis of the femur or pelvis

s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute left leg pain and weakness with systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Increasing left leg pain and weakness
Bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement
key_facts: One week of increasing left leg pain and weakness
Anorexia and 12% body-weight loss over six months
Low blood pressure responsive to IV fluids
Neurologic examination showed 4/5 strength in left hip and knee flexors and extensors
Worsening left hip pain despite analgesia
Decline in strength to 2/5 at the hip and 3/5 at the knee
Small anterior joint effusion on left hip ultrasound
No evidence of malignancy on MRI of the hip and isotope bone scan

salient_findings: Increasing left leg pain and weakness

differentials: Osteomyelitis of the femur or pelvis
Avascular necrosis of the femoral head
Neoplastic processes such as lymphoma or metastatic disease

shortlist: Osteomyelitis of the femur or pelvis

shortlist.label: Psoas abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated inflammatory markers and worsening left hip pain despite analgesia

shortlist.label: Pyomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement on MRI

shortlist.label: Septic arthritis of the hip
shortlist.why_kept: Small anterior joint effusion on left hip ultrasound and rising CRP and ESR

shortlist.label: Osteomyelitis of the femur or pelvis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated inflammatory markers and decline in strength to 2/5 at the hip and 3/5 at the knee

shortlist.label: Polymyalgia rheumatica
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic inflammation and proximal muscle weakness

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of increasing left leg pain and weakness, impaired mobility, and elevated inflammatory markers, along with the MRI findings of bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement, is most consistent with pyomyositis, a bacterial infection of the skeletal muscle.

rejected.label: Psoas abscess
rejected.why: The MRI did not show an abscess in the psoas muscle

rejected.label: Septic arthritis of the hip
rejected.why: The hip ultrasound and MRI did not show evidence of septic arthritis

rejected.label: Osteomyelitis of the femur or pelvis
rejected.why: The MRI and isotope bone scan did not show evidence of osteomyelitis

rejected.label: Polymyalgia rheumatica
rejected.why: The patient's age and symptoms could suggest polymyalgia rheumatica, but the presence of focal muscle oedema and elevated inflammatory markers is more consistent with pyomyositis
